Three pulls beats ten minutes with a knife

No cord to plug in, no charging, no bulky food processor to wash.

1

Load it

Quarter your onion, garlic, herbs or nuts and drop them in the clear bowl. Pick 600ml for a salsa-for-two, 1000ml for family prep.

2

Pull the string

Hold the lid, pull the handle. Each pull spins the curved cutter — more pulls, finer chop. The silicone anti-slip mat keeps the bowl planted while you pull.

3

Tip it out, rinse it clean

Easy cleaning — no motor base, no blades hidden in a machine. Empty, rinse, and it goes back in a drawer, not on your counter forever.

Which size should I get — 600ml or 1000ml?
